name: Yamaha BW80 / BW200 Big Wheel
engine: 79 to 348 cc air-cooled single, two- or four-stroke, fat tires
intro: Yamaha's fat-tire trail bikes. The BW80 is a two-stroke; the BW200 and BW350 are four-strokes.

B: The BW80 is a two-stroke with oil injection. The bigger ones are four-strokes. Check which one you have.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
